text: As I move from the sterile quiet of the glass-walled meeting room into the vibrant, stimulating R+D exhibit, I feel a distinct shift in energy. The first space evokes contemplation and maybe a tinge of alienation—it is organized, calm, almost expectant without occupants. In contrast, the colorful exhibit wall, buzzing with information and innovation, awakens my curiosity and a subtle sense of possibility. Here, the world feels experimental, alive with questions and ideas. I am reminded that places shape not only what I think, but how I feel about thinking itself.
